message.content:
Feature in /opt/nxeon (Next.js 15 + Prisma). Add an owner NOTE to each item on the admin Improvements board, so the owner can write specific instructions for how they want an item handled (before approving). The schema column already exists: `Improvement.ownerNote String?` (do NOT touch prisma/schema.prisma). 

Only edit: components/admin/ImprovementsBoard.tsx, lib/actions-improvements.ts, app/admin/improvements/page.tsx. Read them first.
1. In lib/actions-improvements.ts add `export async function setImprovementNote(id: string, note: string): Promise<void>` — `requireAdmin`-guarded (mirror setImprovementStatus), trims/limits note length (e.g. 4000 chars), `db.improvement.update`, revalidatePath. Remember: a "use server" file may ONLY export async functions.
2. In app/admin/improvements/page.tsx include `ownerNote` in the data passed to the board.
3. In components/admin/ImprovementsBoard.tsx add a small collapsible note editor per card (a textarea + Save button, showing the existing note if set, with a subtle "note" indicator on cards that have one). Use useTransition like the existing status buttons. Keep it on-theme.

CRITICAL: Do NOT run `npm run build` or `next build` (races with other agents). Verify ONLY with `cd /opt/nxeon && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -v "test/.*test.ts"` (clean for your files). Do NOT run git. Report files changed.

Done. Summary of what I implemented for the owner-note feature:

Files changed:
- `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-improvements.ts` — Added `export async function setImprovementNote(id, note)`. It's `requireAdmin`-guarded (mirrors `setImprovementStatus`), trims and caps the note at 4000 chars, writes `null` when empty (clears the note) via `db.improvement.update`, records a best-effort audit log entry, and `revalidatePath("/admin/improvements")`.
- `/opt/nxeon/app/admin/improvements/page.tsx` — Added `ownerNote: r.ownerNote` to the `BoardItem` data passed into `ImprovementsBoard`.
- `/opt/nxeon/components/admin/ImprovementsBoard.tsx` —
  - Imported `setImprovementNote`; added `ownerNote: string | null` to the `BoardItem` type.
  - Added a `saveNote` handler using the existing `useTransition` (so it shares the `pending` state / disabling behavior with the status buttons).
  - In each `Card`: a subtle meta-row toggle that reads "Add note", or "★ Note" (amber) when a note exists, or "Hide note" when open. When collapsed and a note is set, the note renders in a small amber-tinted panel labeled "Owner note". When open, a themed textarea (`maxLength=4000`, 3 rows) with Cancel and Save note buttons; Save is disabled when unchanged.

Verification: `npx tsc --noEmit` (excluding test files) is clean — 0 errors. Did not run any build or git commands.
